class_definition: observed prompt tokens / requested output cap: >=16 prefill_heavy, <=4 decode_heavy, otherwise balanced

cost.basis: operator supplied whole-Pod allocation; includes idle, backoff, drain, validation and disconnect wall time; not invoice or marginal cost

latency_definition: database batch.created_at to accepted task.finished_at; includes durable queue; excludes client upload/admission waiting
limitations: Finite offered-load experiment; no daily or fleet capacity guarantee
Tasks not admitted before the duration cap remain unsubmitted and make the full-plan check fail
Client arrival delay/backpressure is reported separately from database completion latency
GPU activity is device-wide NVML utilization, not Tensor Core utilization or exclusively this job
Engine token counters are cumulative aggregate stage activity; no per-request prefill/decode timestamp is inferred
Periodic queue/quota/cleanup samples cannot reconstruct behavior between samples
No task cancellation, archive/purge call, quota change, history cleanup, or output quality scoring is performed
percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; completion population is completed tasks only

measurement_bounds: HTTP statistics are deltas between successful scrapes of each observed API process; activity before its first scrape is excluded
Intervals spanning a process restart/counter reset are excluded; unobserved requests during such intervals are not reconstructed
p50/p95 are containing Prometheus histogram bucket bounds, not exact quantiles or interpolated point estimates
HTTP durations measure API request handling, not GPU inference task latency; all traffic on observed replicas is included
Database counters aggregate the database; PostgreSQL wait samples are periodic observations, not wait-time durations
Runtime-role visibility of other roles' activity may be redacted; WAL statistics can include other databases on the same cluster
GPU utilization/memory include all workloads visible on each GPU, including unrelated tenants; no GPU process inventory is queried
Database statistics, metrics and GPU probes finish at different times; each source includes its own elapsed time
Polling, metrics aggregation and sampling themselves consume some control-plane/database capacity

sampling_coverage.basis: segments join consecutive samples only when their gap is <=2x target interval; snapshots do not imply continuous observation; outages are never zero-filled

scheduled_latency_definition: accepted task.finished_at minus persisted job start plus deterministic cohort release offset; includes upload, 429 backoff, local concurrency and disconnect delay
